records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for your question about importing from a spreadsheet — your ticket is closed now, and to recap Tariq's answer: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Since it sounds like you're setting up for the team, the other piece is your first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through the first project with you.

Best,
Priya
